sourceClaim: Catalogued mature native Hero assets; original growth provenance retained verbatim. Exact source wood/roots/wounds and native-size individual folded cutouts, with gene-surfaces-v3 materials. No scenery near-mesh simplification. Same-tree Forestmodeler opaque far domes remain approximate, not appearance-certified; geometric certificates cover complete unmasked source triangles only, with whole-support fallback when absent.
